# 3 bed end of terrace house for sale

> REA Brophy Farrell are pleased to bring you 22 Pacelli Road, a three bedroomed end of terrace home set in a mature estate in the heart of Naas town and close to the bank of the Grand Canal. Perfectly located within a short walk of Naas town centre, primary and secondary schools, creches, shops, leisure centre, library, playground and a number of restaurants and bars.

- Energetická náročnost: C
- Lokalita: 22 Pacelli Road, Naas
